transcript.text: Hi Mara, I'm June. I run a small florist shop with a greenhouse nearby, and I'd love to have your hive for pollination this spring. Before I lay out my specific offer, I should mention that my greenhouse will be hosting visiting school groups during the spring, so we'll want to think about placement and safety. The north side of the greenhouse is separated from the visitor path by a fence, which could work well. Let me go ahead and state my proposal: I'd like you to place one hive at my greenhouse from April 22 through May 31. In exchange, I'll pay $240 and provide twelve finished bouquets, with payment at the end of the arrangement. I think the north-side spot behind the fence would keep the bees happy and the school groups safe. Let me know what you think!
